AI Research Radar

12,060 AI papers from arXiv (2024-01 to 2026-09), embedded with a sentence-transformer and grouped into topics. Hover any dot to see the paper; click legend items to show or hide topics.

Code, notebook and semantic search app: github.com/anascs12/ai-research-radar

Paper metadata from the arXiv API. Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability. Analysis by Anas Khan.
